fields.title: Nominal adhesive and seam inventory
fields.finding: Nominal film is .015 lb/ft2 per face/core interface; scarf film .07 kg/m2, splice gap .5 mm at 500 kg/m3, sealing .002 kg/m for both faces. Nominal primer is zero. No AF163 mass tolerance was independently verified; the inherited +/- .005 statement is unused.
fields.next_evidence: Obtain an installed bill including primer, intersections, closeouts, rejected material, repairs and leak barriers; qualify sustained load, thermal cycling and leakage.
